title: POST pipeline stages are clearly separated with explicit error boundaries
description: reader/post/pipeline.rs and lifecycle.rs: each POST pipeline stage (validate → sign → write-to-IPFS → assign-article-number → append-log → index-overview) is a distinct async function. Failure at any stage short-circuits the rest with a structured error. A contributor might want to merge stages for 'efficiency' — resist this. The separation means IPFS writes only happen after validation, article numbers only assigned after IPFS commit, and overview index only written after log append. Inlining the stages would obscure the invariants.
